h1: Custom 8 oz Tools for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom 8 oz tools in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Ideal for promotions, giveaways, and corporate gifts.
introHtml: 8 oz tools offer a compact, lightweight option for everyday carry, making them ideal for promotional giveaways or employee safety kits. Unlike larger tools, these fit comfortably in a pocket or tool pouch. Choose from screwdrivers with magnetic tips, perfect for quick fixes. Imprint your logo or message for lasting brand visibility.
heroAltText: Custom 8 oz tools including a Phillips blade screwdriver with magnet top for promotional use
